benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: option from UCO Bank suited for super-premium users.
highlights: This card is specially designed to provide financial aid to people involved in micro, small or medium enterprises. Handloom weavers, fishermen, small artisans, rickshaw owners, service sector, self-employed individuals etc. are the targeted customers.
The cardholders can avail term loan or cash credit or both.
The repayment period is flexible. Customers can repay the term loan in easy instalments over a period of five years.

The interest rates charged are economical, promoting the MSM businessmen to expand their business easily by taking loans. The interest rate is MCLR of 1 year along with 1.15% p.a. for term loans and cash credit.
UCO Bank Swarojgar Credit Card is valid for 5 years, based on the condition that the account is functional as per bank’s norms. Annual renewal process of the card is effortless and smooth.
